_comment: All values in SI units (metres, seconds, kg, radians) unless noted. Edit freely to tune balance; see knowledge.md in each package for how each constant is used.

movement._comment: v_max = base + scale*top_speed_attr ; a_max = base + scale*acceleration_attr

kicking._comment: sigma_angle in radians = base + scale*(1 - precision^precision_exponent). power in m/s = base + scale*attr. running_power_coefficient: max run boost = coefficient (at full sprint in line with kick). power_base/scale rescaled from 15/20 so full-sprint run_mult=1.7 gives same peak speed as old coeff=0.3 (run_mult=1.3): factor=1.3/1.7=0.765.

passing._comment: Auto-pace for a grounded pass: v = overshoot_factor * sqrt(2*mu_roll*g*distance), clamped to [min,max]. Error model is now unified with kicking (KickingParams) - sigma scales with both precision and effective power.

goalkeeping._comment: 'Save' action: predicts where an incoming shot crosses the keeper's own goal line and moves the keeper there. See engine/knowledge.md for the crossing-point prediction and the ball-freeze-on-pickup rule that makes saves work with the generic possession model.

tackling._comment_angle: Modifier added to tackling boost based on approach angle. angle=0 (frontal, tackler is directly in front of dribbler): +10%; angle=90 (side): -5%; angle=180 (from behind): -65%. Piecewise linear in cos(angle).

control_time._comment: Time (s) for a player to bring a ball under control on first touch. See knowledge.md in engine/ for full derivation.
